sources.information: Official Sziget homepage identifies itself as #SZIGET2027, announces the festival for 10–14 August 2027, and lists some 2027 pass prices. It also describes Sziget in terms of music and artists.
Official Sziget travel page says the festival takes place on Óbuda Island, Budapest, and gives the address as Május 9. park, Budapest, Hungary, 1033.

Official FAQ confirms Sziget Festival 2027 runs 10–14 August and says artists will be announced later. It includes references to Sziget 2026 but does not establish that edition’s programme dates or a complete ticket listing.
Official 2027 tickets page was inspected, but the page extraction did not expose the product listings needed to verify a complete ticket block.
